author: Abdouhoc
quote: A terrible story, boring level design that puts you to sleep. I think they could have easily delivered 60 FPS, but they deliberately chose 30 FPS so they could use it as a selling point when the next generation of gaming consoles comes out. The excessive realism is boring. Imagine having to change your car during a police chase simply because the engine broke down or you ran out of gas. And don’t even get me started on the pornographic scenes. Sometimes you feel like you’re watching a porn movie.
